definitions: A type of random process that is often used to model time series data, where the output variable depends linearly on its own previous values and on a stochastic term.
A statistical model that predicts future values based on past values, commonly used in econometrics and signal processing.
examples: The autoregressive model was used to forecast stock prices.
Understanding the parameters of an autoregressive model is crucial for accurate predictions.
Many financial time series can be analyzed using an autoregressive model.
